mentions.name: Freefollow
mentions.description: A private, end-to-end-encrypted social app for sharing picture and video "posts" with a chosen circle of friends and family, offering pub/sub-style following without group texts or toxicity. Built as a React app on Cloudflare Workers with an iOS app in the works using Capacitor, and E2EE built on OPAQUE.
mentions.problem: Group texts are unsatisfying for sharing updates with ~20 people — blasting everyone with texts or putting them all in one group — so the builders wanted something pub/sub with the privacy of E2EE chat apps that is easy enough for parents to use.
mentions.audience: Friends and family of the builders, including less technical users such as parents.
mentions.source_excerpt: For a long time I've been wanting a private, E2EE social media app for sharing pics/videos of my son with friends and family, but haven't found anything fitting that description.
